highlight#

API pages include interactive (HTML) plots that would possibly not render correctly on a mobile device.

highlight(groups: Sequence[str] | str) → DeferredLayer#

Layer that draws the chosen groups in color over every other cell in grey.

Parameters:

groups (Sequence[str] | str) – The groups to highlight, among the categories the plot is colored by. e.g. [“0”, “3”] for two clusters of a plot colored by ‘leiden’.

Returns:

DeferredLayer – Highlight layer, to add to a plot with +.

Raises:

  • EmptySelectionError – If groups is empty.

  • InvalidPlotSpecError – If it is added to a grid of plots (e.g. from umaps) rather than a single plot.

  • MissingAestheticError – If the plot is not colored by a key.

  • NonCategoricalColumnError – If the plot is colored by numeric values (e.g. gene expression).

  • KeyNotFoundError – If a group is not among the categories the plot is colored by.

Notes

Add it last. It redraws the layers before it, so cellestial layers that read the plot’s color (e.g. ondata_legend) must come before it. Layers without the color column (e.g. arrow_axis) are drawn as they are. Only the highlighted groups keep their colors and appear in the legend.

Examples

Highlight two clusters.

import cellestial as cl

data = cl.datasets.pbmc3k()

cl.umap(data, key="leiden") + cl.highlight(["0", "3"])

Highlight a single cell type.

cl.umap(data, key="cell_type_lvl1") + cl.highlight("B Cells")
